description: This file defines the LoanLockingService interface within the Apache Fineract project. It declares methods for managing locks on loan accounts, such as applying, upgrading, deleting, and querying locks based on loan IDs and lock owners.

classes.name: LoanLockingService
classes.description: Interface for managing loan account locks, including applying, upgrading, deleting, and querying locks based on loan IDs and lock owners.

methods.name: upgradeLock
methods.description: Upgrades the lock status for a list of accounts with a specified lock owner.

methods.name: deleteByLoanIdInAndLockOwner
methods.description: Deletes lock records for specified loan IDs associated with a particular lock owner.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdIn
methods.description: Retrieves all lock records associated with a list of loan IDs.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndLockOwner
methods.description: Finds a specific lock for a given loan ID and lock owner.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdInAndLockOwner
methods.description: Retrieves all lock records for a list of loan IDs and a specific lock owner.

methods.name: applyLock
methods.description: Applies locks to a list of loan IDs with a specified lock owner.
